items.title: 4.2 Badalti (variable) force ka kiya kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2 with Figs. 4.5 to 4.8 and Example 4.1 (PDF 76-78).

blocks.text: Aksar work karte waqt force constant nahi rehti. Maslan jab rocket Zameen se door jata hai to woh gravity ki force ke khilaf work karta hai, aur yeh force Zameen ke markaz (centre) se faasle ke square ke ulat (inverse square) badalti hai. Isi tarah spring jitna zyada khinche, us ki force utni barhti hai. Aisi soorat mein work kaise nikalein?

Figure 4.5 mein ek particle (chhota zarra) x y plane mein point P se point Q tak chalta hai. Raste ko n chhote hisson mein baant diya gaya hai, jin ke displacements Δd₁, Δd₂, ……, Δdₙ hain, aur in hisson mein lagne wali forces F₁, F₂, ……, Fₙ hain.

blocks.alt: P se Q tak mura hua rasta nishanon se chhote wuqfon delta d1, delta d2 ... delta dn mein bata hai. Force F1 P par raste se zawiya theta1 par lagti hai, aur force F2 doosre wuqfe ke shuru mein zawiya theta2 par.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.5: Badalti force ke tahat zarra dikhaye gaye raste par nuqte P se nuqte Q tak chalta hai (kitab ki Figure 4.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Har chhote hisse mein force ko taqreeban constant maan lete hain. To pehle hisse ka work yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: ΔW₁ = F₁ · Δd₁ = F₁ cos θ₁ Δd₁
ΔW₂ = F₂ · Δd₂ = F₂ cos θ₂ Δd₂

blocks.text: isi tarah aage bhi. Cheez ko P se Q tak le jane ka kul (total) work in sab ko jama (add) kar ke milta hai:

blocks.latex: = F_1\cos\theta_1\,\Delta d_1 + F_2\cos\theta_2\,\Delta d_2 + \dots + F_n\cos\theta_n\,\Delta d_n
blocks.text_alt: = F₁ cos θ₁ Δd₁ + F₂ cos θ₂ Δd₂ + …… + Fₙ cos θₙ Δdₙ
ya   W_total = Σ (i = 1 to n) Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ   (4.4)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Σ (sigma) ka matlab hai “sab ko jama karo”. Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ yani har chhote hisse ka work (Fᵢ cos θᵢ × Δdᵢ) nikal kar sab ko jor do.

Isay graph se bhi dekh sakte hain: F cos θ ko d ke muqable mein plot karein (Fig. 4.6). Displacement d ko unhi n barabar hisson mein baanta gaya hai, aur har hisse ke shuru mein F cos θ ki qeemat figure mein dikhayi gayi hai.

blocks.alt: F cos theta ka d ke muqable graph, origin O aur axes x, y. P se Q tak displacement barabar wuqfon delta d1, delta d2 ... delta di ... delta dn mein bata hai. Har rangeen patti (strip) ki oonchai us wuqfe ke shuru mein F cos theta ki qeemat hai: F1 cos theta1, Fi cos theta i, Fn cos theta n; hamwar curve un ke oopar se guzarta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.6: d ke muqable F cos theta, n barabar wuqfon mein bata hua (kitab ki Figure 4.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har patti (strip) ka area = Fᵢ cos θᵢ × Δdᵢ, yani us chhote hisse ka work. Sab pattiyan jor dein to kul work milta hai. Pattiyan jitni patli hon, un ka jor curve ke neeche wale area ke utna hi qareeb hota hai.

Ab iᵗʰ (i-wein) rang wale rectangle ka area Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ hai, jo iᵗʰ hisse ka work hai. Is liye Eq. 4.4 ka work sab rectangles ke areas ke jor ke barabar hai. Agar faasle ko bohat zyada hisson mein baant dein taa ke har Δd bohat chhota ho jaye, to Eq. 4.4 ka jawab zyada durust ho jata hai. Aur agar har Δd ko zero ki taraf le jayein (limit) to work ka bilkul theek jawab milta hai:

blocks.text_alt: W_total = Limit (Δd → 0) Σ (i = 1 to n) Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ   (4.5)

blocks.text: Jab Δd zero ki taraf jata hai to rectangles ka kul area (Fig. 4.6) P se Q tak F cos θ – d curve aur x-axis ke darmiyan wale area ke barabar ho jata hai, jo Fig. 4.7 mein rang se dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: F cos theta ka Displacement d ke muqable graph, origin O. P aur Q ke darmiyan hamwar curve ke neeche ka poora hissa rangeen hai, P aur Q par dashed amoodi (vertical) lakeerein.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.7: P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos theta ke muqable d curve ke neeche ka raqba (kitab ki Figure 4.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Is tarah, badalti (variable) force ka do points ke darmiyan particle ko le jane ka work, points P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos θ – d curve ke neeche wale area ke barabar hai (Fig. 4.7).

blocks.title: Example 4.1
blocks.problem: Ek cheez par lagne wali force F faasle d ke saath Fig. 4.8 ki tarah badalti hai. Cheez d = 0 se d = 6 m tak jaye to force ka work nikalein.
steps: Force ka work d = 0 se d = 6 m tak curve ke neeche wale kul area ke barabar hai. Yeh area do hisson ka jor hai: d = 0 se d = 4 m tak rectangle, aur d = 4 m se d = 6 m tak triangle (tikon).
Rectangle ka work = 4 m × 5 N = 20 N m = 20 J
Triangle ka work = ½ × 2 m × 5 N = 5 N m = 5 J

blocks.alt: F (newton, 0 se 5) ka d (metre, 0 se 6) ke muqable graph. d = 0 se 4 m tak force 5 N hai, phir seedhi lakeer mein d = 6 m par sifr ho jati hai. Graph ke neeche 0 se 4 m ka mustateel aur 4 se 6 m ki tikon (triangle) do rangon mein hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.8: Example 4.1 ke liye force aur faasle ka graph (kitab ki Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Constant aur variable force ka muqabla
rows: W = limit (Δd → 0) Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ
F cos θ – d curve ke neeche ka area

blocks.prompt: 0.5 kg ka jism seedhi lakeer mein velocity v = a y^(3/2) se chalta hai, jahan a = 5 m^(−1/2) s⁻¹. y = 0 se y = 5 m tak net force ka work nikalein (numerical problem 4.9).
blocks.explanation: Net force ka work = kinetic energy ki tabdeeli (work-energy theorem, topic 4.7). y = 5 m par v = 5 × 5^(3/2) = 5 × 11.18 = 55.9 m s⁻¹, aur y = 0 par v = 0. To W = ½ × 0.5 × (55.9)² − 0 = 781.25 J, jo kitab ka jawab hai. Yahan force jagah ke saath badalti hai, is liye seedha W = Fd nahi lag sakta.

items: Variable force (rocket par gravity, spring): rasta chhote hisson Δd mein kaatein, har hisse mein force constant maanein: W = Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ (4.4).
Δd → 0 ki limit mein work = P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos θ – d curve ke neeche ka area (4.5). Example 4.1: 20 J + 5 J = 25 J.
